fusions.name: Throw the Bolt
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy carrying one of your afflictions, and uses one up. Slams a lock bolt home on it, which deals 9 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 2 seconds and 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Portcullis Drop
fusions.desc: Releases a ring of counterweighted bars around you, which deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stuns each for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Shutter Gate
fusions.desc: Rolls down a barred shutter 5 tiles long for 8 seconds. Nothing crosses it, and anything that touches it moves 25% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Grounded Mesh
fusions.desc: A wire mesh around you sends 12% of the elemental damage you take back to whoever dealt it. Your lightning resistance rises by 10%.
